(1) incremental expected cash flows are the most appropriate tool to cope with conflicts of interest, (2) the information sets to incremental cash flows are the key to understanding conflicts of interest, and (3) conflicts of interest can be reduced or eliminated by designing restrictive covenants based on incremental expected cash flows.

the design of ex ante contracts that can be used to cope with conflicts of interest.
the design of ex ante contracts and ex post monitoring devices, both of which are aimed at reducing conflicts of interest.
